verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://svelte.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a 'Svelte Documentation for LLMs' header. First-party docs also ship multiple agent-oriented variants: llms-small.txt, llms-medium.txt, and per-section llms.txt files for the CLI, Kit and AI docs. The AI docs additionally describe an MCP server that feeds documentation to agents, so every element of the story is covered by first-party docs plus probe corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://svelte.dev/llms.txt # Svelte Documentation for LLMs
The Svelte MCP (Model Context Protocol) server can help your agent write better Svelte code. It works by providing relevant documentation, and statically analysing generated code
claude mcp add -t stdio -s [scope] svelte -- npx -y @sveltejs/mcp
